paper_title: Solar neutrino limit on axions and keV-mass bosons
notes: Headline result from the abstract and Eq. (4): g_agamma < 7e-10 GeV^-1, a new solar energy-loss limit derived from the SNO all-flavor solar neutrino flux (La < 0.1 L_sun, Eq. 3). Paper's Lagrangian L_ag = -(1/4) g_ag F Ftilde a matches the canonical AxionPhoton definition exactly; no conversion needed. Flat horizontal limit reported as two points; the paper states the bound applies to sub-keV-mass axions (inner solar temperature ~1 keV), so I set the upper mass edge at ~1 keV (1e3 eV) and extend the flat line down to low mass. Not a dark-matter search, so no density assumed. The limit is a 'nominal/reasonably conservative' bound (50% flux excess -> La < 0.1 L_sun), not a stated statistical CL, so confidence_level is null. Secondary results (boson-electron Yukawa g_eechi limits for PS/S/V vs m_chi in Fig. 1) not reported; AxionPhoton is the presented main result.
